title: How You’re Secretly Leaking Your Personal Data #shorts
description:
Think massive hacks are the only threat to your data? Think again. You're probably leaking your personal data through dozens of tiny permissions and everyday habits. From hidden GPS coordinates in your photos to smart TV tracking and sneaky browser extensions, here are 5 privacy mistakes you are making every day.

Which privacy mistake surprised you the most? Let me know in the comments! 👇
